slot.brief: Photon emitted in transition between two levels of hydrogen-like ion (Z given); compute its energy

stem: A hydrogen-like lithium ion ($Z=3$) emits a photon when its electron moves from the $n=3$ level to the $n=2$ level. The energy of the photon is

verdicts.working: For a hydrogen-like ion, ΔE = 13.6Z²(1/2² − 1/3²) eV = 13.6 × 9 × 5/36 = 17.0 eV.

working:
$E_\gamma=13.6Z^2\left(\dfrac{1}{2^2}-\dfrac{1}{3^2}\right)$ eV
$=13.6(9)\left(\dfrac{5}{36}\right)$ eV
$=17.0$ eV

Independent check: For a hydrogen-like ion, ΔE = 13.6Z²(1/2² − 1/3²) eV = 13.6 × 9 × 5/36 = 17.0 eV.
